title: 介词短语与固定表达
description: 日常交流和阅读中最常见的介词短语、连接表达与固定说法：at least、as soon as、in spite of、no wonder……

entries.example: I studied for more than two hours, and afterward I went to bed.
entries.translation: 我学习了两个多小时，然后就去睡觉了。

entries.example: She is busy right now and she can't speak with you.
entries.translation: 她现在很忙，不能和你说话。

entries.example: I can't believe your parents let you come here by yourself.
entries.translation: 我不敢相信你父母让你自己过来。

entries.example: I don't know at all why he quit his job suddenly.
entries.translation: 我完全不明白他为什么突然辞职。

entries.example: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.
entries.translation: 他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。

entries.example: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
entries.translation: 他擅长解答数学难题。

entries.example: Gordon is interested in the Japanese way of life.
entries.translation: 戈登对日本的生活方式感兴趣。

entries.example: She speaks French and Spanish, and she knows some German as well.
entries.translation: 她会说法语和西班牙语，还会一点德语。

entries.example: The car in front stopped suddenly, so I had to brake hard.
entries.translation: 前面的车突然停下，我只好急刹车。

entries.example: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English.
entries.translation: 说英语时不要害怕犯错。

entries.example: All of a sudden, three dogs appeared in front of us.
entries.translation: 突然，三只狗出现在我们面前。

entries.example: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.
entries.translation: 我想要一艘能带我远离这里的船。

entries.example: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
entries.translation: 大多数人每天至少刷两次牙。

entries.example: I will give you a call as soon as I get home.
entries.translation: 我一回到家就给你打电话。

entries.example: If you sleep for a while, you will feel much better.
entries.translation: 如果小睡一会儿，你会感觉好多了。

entries.example: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
entries.translation: 由于经济衰退，失业率上升到了5%。

entries.example: He once knew her, but they are no longer friends.
entries.translation: 他曾经认识她，但他们现在不再是朋友了。

entries.example: It's next to impossible to finish it in a day.
entries.translation: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

entries.example: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.
entries.translation: 我不想再听你抱怨了。

entries.example: If a guy's in love with you, he'll think about you all the time.
entries.translation: 如果一个男生爱上你，他会时时刻刻想着你。

entries.example: Young people are usually full of energy.
entries.translation: 年轻人通常充满活力。

entries.example: The weather today is great, but lately it's been raining all the time.
entries.translation: 今天天气很好，但最近一直在下雨。

entries.example: She warned him not to go out at night alone.
entries.translation: 她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

entries.example: I am in the habit of taking a shower in the morning.
entries.translation: 我习惯早上洗澡。

entries.example: The train was delayed, so I could not arrive there on time.
entries.translation: 火车晚点了，所以我不能准时赶到那里。

entries.example: Do you think he did the job on his own?
entries.translation: 你认为他是自己独立完成这项工作的吗？

entries.example: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
entries.translation: 鲨鱼对电信号和声音都很敏感。

entries.example: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
entries.translation: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。

entries.example: Even though he was tired, he went on with his work.
entries.translation: 他虽然很累，但还是继续工作。

entries.example: He went on reading the book as if nothing had happened.
entries.translation: 他继续读书，好像什么事也没有发生。

entries.example: Since I had met him once before, I recognized him right away.
entries.translation: 因为我以前见过他一次，所以我马上就认出他了。

entries.example: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
entries.translation: 我想知道，你每天做同样的事情会不会觉得厌烦？

entries.example: My grandfather wants to live quietly for the rest of his life.
entries.translation: 我的外公想安静地度过晚年。

entries.example: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.
entries.translation: 租的房子应该离我工作的地方近一些。

entries.example: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
entries.translation: 你能把自行车借我用几天吗？

entries.example: I like rugby, but not as much as I like basketball.
entries.translation: 我喜欢橄榄球，但不如喜欢篮球那么多。

entries.example: When using this information, I will of course follow your requirements.
entries.translation: 使用这些信息时，我当然会遵循你的要求。

entries.example: She always keeps her desk in order so she can find things quickly.
entries.translation: 她总是把书桌收拾得整整齐齐，以便能很快找到东西。

entries.example: According to the weather report, the rainy season will start next week.
entries.translation: 根据天气预报，雨季下周开始。

entries.example: If you sleep for a while, you will feel much better.
entries.translation: 小睡一会儿，你会感觉好很多。

entries.example: Instead of going to Europe, I decided to go to America.
entries.translation: 我决定去美国，而不是去欧洲。

entries.example: There are pyramids all over the world, not only in Egypt.
entries.translation: 世界各地都有金字塔，不只是埃及。

entries.example: No matter how often I tell her, she keeps making the same mistake.
entries.translation: 不管我跟她说多少次，她还是犯同样的错误。

entries.example: It would be better for you to stay in bed today.
entries.translation: 你今天最好卧床休息。

entries.example: He can play computer games as long as he does his homework.
entries.translation: 只要他做完作业，就可以玩电脑游戏。

entries.example: Even if I had enough money, I still wouldn't buy a Ferrari.
entries.translation: 即使我的钱够了，我也不会买一辆法拉利。

entries.example: Due to bad weather, the plane arrived three hours late.
entries.translation: 由于天气不好，飞机迟到了3小时。

entries.example: It's already very late, but he is still at work.
entries.translation: 已经很晚了，但是他还在工作。

entries.example: There is a park in the middle of the city.
entries.translation: 城市中央有一座公园。

entries.example: In order to avoid misunderstandings, they went through the contract again.
entries.translation: 为了避免误解，他们又过了一遍合同。

entries.example: Mom took the blanket along with the bedsheet to wash.
entries.translation: 妈妈把被单连同床单一起拿去洗了。

entries.example: Maybe I will have to spend my entire life in prison.
entries.translation: 也许我不得不在监狱里度过一生。

entries.example: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?
entries.translation: 在这栋楼里拍照可以吗？

entries.example: Despite all of the traffic we managed to make it in time.
entries.translation: 尽管交通拥堵，我们还是设法及时赶到了。

entries.example: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
entries.translation: 她因为丢了护照而遇到了麻烦。

entries.example: Send for the doctor at once, or the patient may get worse.
entries.translation: 立刻派人去请医生，否则病人的情况可能会恶化。

entries.example: At first I did not like rock music, but now I do.
entries.translation: 起初我不喜欢摇滚乐，但现在喜欢了。

entries.example: She hurried to the station so that she wouldn't miss the train.
entries.translation: 她匆忙赶到车站，以免错过火车。

entries.example: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
entries.translation: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。

entries.example: The time will come when you will be sorry for it.
entries.translation: 总有一天你会为此后悔的。

entries.example: I really want to know what's going on.
entries.translation: 我真想知道发生了什么事。

entries.example: There is no way of knowing where he is.
entries.translation: 无法知道他去了哪里。

entries.example: Fish such as carp and trout live in fresh water.
entries.translation: 鲤鱼和鳟鱼等鱼类生活在淡水中。

entries.example: Don't worry. We have plenty of water and food.
entries.translation: 别担心。我们有充足的水和食物。

entries.example: We talked on the phone with our uncle.
entries.translation: 我们和叔叔通了电话。

entries.example: Every time I hear that song, I think of my high school days.
entries.translation: 每次听到那首歌，我都会想起高中时光。

entries.example: Some people read the newspaper and watch TV at the same time.
entries.translation: 有些人一边看报纸一边看电视。

entries.example: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
entries.translation: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。

entries.example: How about going to see a movie tonight?
entries.translation: 今晚看电影怎么样？

entries.example: I can't recall her name at the moment.
entries.translation: 我突然想不起她的名字。

entries.example: I have no more time to talk with you.
entries.translation: 我没有更多时间跟你说话了。

entries.example: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.
entries.translation: 我去澳大利亚旅行时第一次穿越了赤道。

entries.example: As far as I know, there is nothing wrong with his plan.
entries.translation: 据我所知，他的计划没有问题。

entries.example: I don't want to be involved in this affair.
entries.translation: 我不想卷入这件事。

entries.example: I have too many things on my mind these days.
entries.translation: 这些天我脑子里的事情太多了。

entries.example: The tall man left in a hurry.
entries.translation: 那个高个子男人匆匆离开了。

entries.example: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.
entries.translation: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。

entries.example: The manager ordered all the rooms to be swept clean as soon as possible.
entries.translation: 经理命令尽快把所有房间打扫干净。

entries.example: Even though I studied English for 6 years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.
entries.translation: 尽管我在学校学了六年英语，我还是说不好。

entries.example: It seems that the rainy season is over at last.
entries.translation: 雨季似乎终于结束了。

entries.example: I thought he was going to fail the exam, but he passed after all.
entries.translation: 我原以为他考试会不及格，但他最终还是通过了。

entries.example: Keep an eye on the child for me for a moment.
entries.translation: 帮我看会儿孩子。

entries.example: More and more doctors have begun to use the new medicine.
entries.translation: 越来越多的医生开始使用这种新药。

entries.example: I just talked to the person in charge.
entries.translation: 我刚跟负责人谈过。

entries.example: I got soaked by the rain on the way home.
entries.translation: 我在回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

entries.example: What do I have to do now that I'm registered?
entries.translation: 既然我已经注册了，现在该做什么？

entries.example: An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
entries.translation: 汽车数量的增加会影响城市环境。

entries.example: If you can't come, you should let me know ahead of time.
entries.translation: 如果你不能来，应该提前告诉我。

entries.example: About how long will it take to get there by bus?
entries.translation: 坐公共汽车到那里大约要花多长时间？

entries.example: I feel like going out rather than staying at home today.
entries.translation: 我今天想外出，不想待在家里。

entries.example: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
entries.translation: 那些葡萄看起来是甜的，但其实是酸的。

entries.example: I have not yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
entries.translation: 我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。

entries.example: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
entries.translation: 当她的孩子在公共场合表现不好时，她感到很尴尬。

entries.example: Are you saying that my life is in danger?
entries.translation: 你是说我的生命有危险吗？

entries.example: I got this CD player for free.
entries.translation: 我免费得到了这台CD播放机。

entries.example: He stepped on my foot on purpose.
entries.translation: 他故意踩了我的脚。

entries.example: You had better take an umbrella with you in case it rains.
entries.translation: 你最好带把伞，以防下雨。

entries.example: I considered changing my job, but in the end I decided not to.
entries.translation: 我考虑过换工作，但最后还是决定不换。

entries.example: Sooner or later he will tell me everything.
entries.translation: 他迟早会把一切都告诉我。

entries.example: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
entries.translation: 数以百计的人在售票处等候。

entries.example: I never spoke to him after that.
entries.translation: 之后我再也没跟他说过话。

entries.example: We'll get a phone call from him tonight for sure.
entries.translation: 今晚我们肯定会接到他的电话。

entries.example: The climate here is very similar to that of England.
entries.translation: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。

entries.example: I haven't eaten Chinese food in a while.
entries.translation: 我好一阵子没吃过中国菜了。

entries.example: If you want to sell your old sofa, why not put an advertisement in the local paper?
entries.translation: 你要是想卖掉旧沙发，何不在本地报纸上登个广告呢？

entries.example: Nothing is more boring than traveling long distances by car.
entries.translation: 没有什么比长途乘车旅行更无聊的了。

entries.example: They waited in line for the bus.
entries.translation: 他们排队等公交车。

entries.example: I heard a dog barking in the distance.
entries.translation: 我听到远处传来狗叫声。

entries.example: Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire.
entries.translation: 你看，那边在冒烟。那栋楼一定是着火了。

entries.example: My parents got divorced a long time ago.
entries.translation: 我父母很久以前就离婚了。

entries.example: I've done this all my life.
entries.translation: 这活儿我干了一辈子。

entries.example: An electric guitar doesn't sound the same as an acoustic one.
entries.translation: 电吉他的声音听起来和木吉他不一样。

entries.example: In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.
entries.translation: 在我看来，这个问题很难解决。

entries.example: I came to Tokyo three years ago and have been living here ever since.
entries.translation: 三年前我来到东京，并一直住在这里。

entries.example: The shutter's over here. All you have to do is press it.
entries.translation: 快门在这里。你只需要按下它就行了。

entries.example: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.
entries.translation: 会议将于后天在东京举行。

entries.example: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.
entries.translation: 据说鲸鱼很久以前生活在陆地上。

entries.example: So what if that's true?
entries.translation: 就算那是真的，那又怎样？

entries.example: You'll have to study harder from now on.
entries.translation: 从现在起，你要更努力学习了。

entries.example: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
entries.translation: 房间里除了一张破旧的床以外，什么都没有。

entries.example: Being ill, I stayed at home all day long.
entries.translation: 我生病了，在家待了一整天。

entries.example: I'm not at all satisfied with this result.
entries.translation: 我对这个结果一点也不满意。

entries.example: By the way, how many of you are keeping a diary?
entries.translation: 顺便问一下，你们当中有几个人在写日记？

entries.example: Let's assume this is correct for now.
entries.translation: 我们姑且认为这是对的。

entries.example: Thank you once again for your attention.
entries.translation: 再次感谢您的关注。

entries.example: How long does it take from here to your house on foot?
entries.translation: 从这里步行到你家需要多长时间？

entries.example: The price of coffee has doubled since then.
entries.translation: 从那以后，咖啡的价格翻了一番。

entries.example: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
entries.translation: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。

entries.example: Did you go abroad for pleasure or on business?
entries.translation: 你出国是去玩儿还是出差？

entries.example: There is no chance of rain today.
entries.translation: 今天不可能下雨。

entries.example: What about going out for a meal?
entries.translation: 出去吃顿饭怎么样？

entries.example: He owes his success both to working hard and to good luck.
entries.translation: 他的成功既归功于努力工作，也归功于好运。

entries.example: He put the key on the desk as usual.
entries.translation: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。

entries.example: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.
entries.translation: 带这群孩子去图书馆不成问题。

entries.example: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.
entries.translation: 他因抢劫罪入狱。

entries.example: There are pyramids all over the world, not only in Egypt.
entries.translation: 世界各地都有金字塔，不只是埃及。

entries.example: I got up early to be in time for the train.
entries.translation: 为了赶上那趟火车，我特意起了个大早。

entries.example: I don't like people talking about me behind my back.
entries.translation: 我不喜欢别人在背后议论我。

entries.example: Just now I was chatting with my parents.
entries.translation: 刚才我在和父母聊天。

entries.example: She was worn out from overwork.
entries.translation: 她因过度劳累而筋疲力尽。

entries.example: The teacher asked me to read the sentence over again.
entries.translation: 老师让我把这个句子再读一遍。

entries.example: I went on holiday to Scotland this summer.
entries.translation: 今年夏天我去苏格兰度假了。

entries.example: You'd better not smoke while on duty.
entries.translation: 值班时你最好不要吸烟。

entries.example: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?
entries.translation: 老板不在时谁负责办公室？

entries.example: That's not exactly what I had in mind.
entries.translation: 那并不完全是我想要的。

entries.example: She was at his bedside for the whole time he was ill.
entries.translation: 他生病期间，她一直守在他床边。

entries.example: To be honest, I've never heard of this place before.
entries.translation: 说实话，我以前从没听说过这个地方。

entries.example: Would you mind saying that once more?
entries.translation: 请你再说一次好吗？

entries.example: I use all kinds of software to study Chinese.
entries.translation: 我用各种各样的软件学习中文。

entries.example: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
entries.translation: 自从我在房子上安装了太阳能电池板，我的电费就减少了一半。

entries.example: They drive on the left in England.
entries.translation: 在英国，人们靠左行驶。

entries.example: It's too bad the college dining hall doesn't have fig cookies.
entries.translation: 可惜大学食堂没有无花果饼干。

entries.example: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
entries.translation: 由于空气污染问题，自行车也许有一天会取代汽车。

entries.example: He has dozens of books about Japan.
entries.translation: 他有几十本关于日本的书。

entries.example: I heard the news on the radio.
entries.translation: 我从收音机里听到了这个消息。

entries.example: I've got to go to bed. Good night.
entries.translation: 我要睡觉了，晚安。

entries.example: She expects to have finished her second novel by November, just in time for Christmas.
entries.translation: 她预计将在11月完成第二本小说，正好赶上圣诞节。

entries.example: Jack was pacing up and down in the room, lost in thought.
entries.translation: 杰克在房间里来回踱步，陷入沉思。

entries.example: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.
entries.translation: 他背周期表只是为了好玩。

entries.example: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.
entries.translation: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。

entries.example: He walked back and forth on the platform while waiting for the train.
entries.translation: 他在站台上一边等火车，一边来回踱步。

entries.example: Coming face to face with a dinosaur was a funny experience.
entries.translation: 和一只恐龙面对面是一段有趣的经历。

entries.example: I met my teacher by accident at the restaurant last night.
entries.translation: 昨晚我在餐厅里碰见了老师。

entries.example: The doctor will be here in a minute.
entries.translation: 医生马上就来。

entries.example: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
entries.translation: 她很乐意来，但她当时正在休假。

entries.example: I still prefer to write letters by hand.
entries.translation: 我还是更喜欢用手写信。

entries.example: An earthquake can take place at any time.
entries.translation: 地震随时都可能发生。

entries.example: We stopped over in Los Angeles for two nights on the way to New Zealand.
entries.translation: 我们在去新西兰的途中在洛杉矶停留了两晚。

entries.example: She lives just across from us.
entries.translation: 她就住在我们对面。

entries.example: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
entries.translation: 总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。

entries.example: His English is not bad, seeing that he has studied for only two years.
entries.translation: 考虑到他只学了两年英文，他的英语说得还不错。

entries.example: What's the matter? You look very angry.
entries.translation: 怎么了？你看起来很生气。

entries.example: I'll drop by the post office on the way home.
entries.translation: 我会在回家的路上顺便去邮局。

entries.example: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
entries.translation: 我把他带到校园里最贵的餐馆去了。

entries.example: They arrived in Osaka at the beginning of May.
entries.translation: 他们在五月初抵达了大阪。

entries.example: My job will only last two years at most.
entries.translation: 我的工作最多只能持续两年。

entries.example: This is certainly not the best solution, but it may work for now.
entries.translation: 这绝不是最好的办法，但也许目前行得通。

entries.example: It was raining on and off all night long.
entries.translation: 雨整夜时下时停。

entries.example: Will you excuse me for just a moment?
entries.translation: 不好意思，我失陪一下。

entries.example: I bought a set of brand new speakers.
entries.translation: 我买了一套全新的音箱。

entries.example: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
entries.translation: 他每次逃跑都回到这个地区。

entries.example: Just a minute, please. I'll call him to the phone.
entries.translation: 请稍等。我去叫他接电话。

entries.example: Well done! Your parents must be proud of you.
entries.translation: 干得好！你父母一定为你感到骄傲。

entries.example: As I am off duty today, let's go to the beach.
entries.translation: 我今天不当班，不如一起去海滩玩吧。

entries.example: After a while, the children settled down.
entries.translation: 过了一会儿，孩子们安静下来了。

entries.example: The project seemed simple in the beginning, but it soon became complicated.
entries.translation: 这个项目一开始看起来很简单，但很快就变得复杂了。

entries.example: Ladies and gentlemen, please allow me to say a few words of welcome.
entries.translation: 女士们，先生们，请允许我说几句欢迎的话。

entries.example: Are you going by air or by train?
entries.translation: 你乘飞机还是乘火车去？

entries.example: Thanks a lot. I don't know what we would do without you.
entries.translation: 非常感谢。我不知道没有你我们该怎么办。

entries.example: Good evening. How many are in your party?
entries.translation: 晚上好。请问你们一共几位？

entries.example: Never mind. Anyone can make mistakes.
entries.translation: 没关系，谁都会犯错。

entries.example: You can't master a foreign language in a short time; you have to study it step by step.
entries.translation: 你无法在短时间内掌握一门外语；你必须一步一步地学习。

entries.example: How much is the rent per month?
entries.translation: 每月租金是多少？

entries.example: This pair of trousers is just right for me.
entries.translation: 这条裤子我穿正合适。

entries.example: His only wish was to see his son one last time.
entries.translation: 他唯一的愿望，就是再见儿子最后一面。

entries.example: Would you excuse us one moment?
entries.translation: 能失陪一下吗？

entries.example: A flock of birds whirled across the sky.
entries.translation: 一群鸟旋转着掠过天空。

entries.example: He will be back in a second.
entries.translation: 他很快就会回来。

entries.example: Do you travel by sea or by air?
entries.translation: 你旅行是乘船还是乘飞机？

entries.example: The only thing that matters is that we are all together.
entries.translation: 唯一重要的是我们在一起。

entries.example: The interview was broadcast on television to millions of viewers.
entries.translation: 那次采访在电视上向数百万观众播出。

entries.example: What a pity that I did not see it.
entries.translation: 真遗憾，我没有看到它。

entries.example: The baby weighed seven pounds at birth.
entries.translation: 婴儿出生时重七磅。

entries.example: I'm warning you for the last time.
entries.translation: 我最后一次警告你。

entries.meaning: 衣着讲究的，穿着得体的
entries.example: He is well dressed, but he is anything but a gentleman.
entries.translation: 他衣着讲究，却绝不是个绅士。

entries.example: My children fill me with pride.
entries.translation: 我的孩子们让我充满自豪。

entries.example: In the old days we would go ice skating in the winter, but now we are too old.
entries.translation: 过去冬天我们常去滑冰，但现在我们年纪太大了。

entries.example: The teacher asked the students to practice the dialogue in pairs.
entries.translation: 老师让学生两人一组练习对话。

entries.example: We talked in a low voice so as not to be heard.
entries.translation: 我们小声交谈，以免被人听到。

entries.example: Let's tackle these problems one at a time.
entries.translation: 让我们逐个解决这些问题。

entries.example: The shopkeeper was tired of chasing his debtors so from then on he demanded payment in full.
entries.translation: 店主厌倦了向欠债人讨债，从那时起他便要求全额付款。

entries.example: The island lies to the west of Japan.
entries.translation: 这个岛屿位于日本的西边。

entries.example: What a coincidence! We're wearing the same tie.
entries.translation: 真巧！我们系着同样的领带。

entries.example: There was an old castle to the east of the town.
entries.translation: 小镇东边有一座古老的城堡。

entries.example: Long long ago, there lived a pretty girl.
entries.translation: 很久很久以前，住着一个漂亮的小女孩。

entries.example: I'd gladly pay more for something if it's of high quality.
entries.translation: 如果东西质量好，我会乐意多付点钱。

entries.example: It is up to you whether to buy it or not.
entries.translation: 买不买由你决定。

entries.example: She handed me the letter, and with that she walked out of the room.
entries.translation: 她把信递给我，接着就走出了房间。

entries.example: Much as I would like to help you, I simply don't have the time.
entries.translation: 虽然我很想帮你，但我实在没有时间。

entries.example: The exam wasn't all that difficult, so most students finished early.
entries.translation: 考试并没有那么难，所以大多数学生都提前做完了。

entries.example: My grandfather is over eighty, but he is still very with it.
entries.translation: 我爷爷八十多岁了，但头脑仍然很敏锐。

entries.example: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
entries.translation: 我一抱起婴儿，他就开始哭了。

entries.example: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.
entries.translation: 我的汉语并不完美，但能大致听懂他所说的。

entries.example: It's sort of fashionable, but the price is too high!
entries.translation: 这有点时髦，但价格太高了！

entries.example: For all the money he has, he is not happy.
entries.translation: 尽管他有那么多钱，他并不快乐。

entries.example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
entries.translation: 新鲜水果和蔬菜对你的健康有益。

entries.example: I'm sure they're all aware of what happened.
entries.translation: 我确信他们都意识到发生了什么。

entries.example: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
entries.translation: 公交车司机对乘客的安全负责。

entries.example: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
entries.translation: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？

entries.example: If a tiger suddenly appeared in front of me, I'd be scared to death.
entries.translation: 如果一只老虎突然出现在我面前，我肯定吓死了。

entries.example: Your telegram arrived just as I was about to telephone you.
entries.translation: 我正想打电话给你，你的电报就送来了。

entries.example: She wants to move out and find a place of her own.
entries.translation: 她想搬出去，找个属于自己的地方。

entries.example: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
entries.translation: 我再也无法忍受那噪音了。

entries.example: At the time, I managed to make myself understood in English.
entries.translation: 当时我设法让别人听懂我说的英语。

entries.example: I have to go now, so long, and good luck with your new job.
entries.translation: 我现在得走了，再见，祝你的新工作顺利。

entries.example: My parents had already eaten by the time I got home.
entries.translation: 我回到家的时候，爸爸妈妈都已经吃完饭了。

entries.example: She left an hour ago so she should've arrived by now.
entries.translation: 她一小时前就出发了，所以现在应该已经到了。

entries.example: The trip cost us five hundred dollars in all.
entries.translation: 这次旅行总共花了我们五百美元。

entries.example: Due to the lack of water, many of the plants have withered.
entries.translation: 由于缺水，许多植物干枯了。

entries.example: Science is still not capable of solving all of life's problems.
entries.translation: 科学仍然无法解决生活中的所有问题。

entries.example: It's not that I am unsympathetic, but I am not able to help you.
entries.translation: 并不是我没有同情心，而是我实在帮不了你。

entries.example: It hardly ever snows here in the winter.
entries.translation: 这里的冬天很少下雪。

entries.example: "What if you're wrong?" "I'm not wrong."
entries.translation: “如果你错了呢？”“我不会错的。”

entries.example: I was just about to leave the house when the telephone rang.
entries.translation: 我正要出门时电话响了。

entries.example: The train was so crowded that I had to stand all the way.
entries.translation: 火车拥挤极了，我整趟车程都没有位子坐。

entries.example: The employees were kept in the dark about the factory's closure.
entries.translation: 员工们对工厂关闭一事一无所知。

entries.example: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
entries.translation: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。

entries.example: He threw away a bunch of old letters.
entries.translation: 他扔掉了一堆旧信。

entries.example: He lives in the woods all by himself.
entries.translation: 他独自住在森林里。

entries.example: Lots of people enjoy camping, but I, for one, prefer hotels.
entries.translation: 很多人喜欢露营，但就我而言，我更愿意住酒店。

entries.example: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.
entries.translation: 前几天我人生中第一次去钓鱼。

entries.example: I went to Hawaii on vacation for a couple of weeks.
entries.translation: 我去夏威夷度了几周假。

entries.example: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
entries.translation: 你回家途中顺道来我家坐坐吧。

entries.example: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.
entries.translation: 多亏了顺风，我们很快就到了那个小岛。

entries.example: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
entries.translation: 如果有紧急的事，你可以联系我。

entries.example: In his eyes, nothing is more important than family.
entries.translation: 在他看来，没有什么比家庭更重要。

entries.example: The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
entries.translation: 番茄容易患多种病害。

entries.example: She broke the chocolate bar in two and shared it with her friend.
entries.translation: 她把那块巧克力掰成两半，和朋友一起分着吃了。

entries.example: If only I could speak English as fluently as you!
entries.translation: 要是我英语能说得像你一样流利就好了！

entries.example: There is no way of reaching the island other than by boat.
entries.translation: 除了乘船，没有别的办法到达那个岛。

entries.example: I hate the English language and everything related to it.
entries.translation: 我讨厌英语以及一切与它有关的东西。

entries.example: I got up earlier than usual in order to catch the first train.
entries.translation: 为了赶上第一班火车，我比平时起得早。

entries.example: To tell the truth, I would rather stay at home than go out.
entries.translation: 说实话，我宁愿待在家里，也不想出去。

entries.example: I'm sick of listening to her complaints.
entries.translation: 我听她抱怨听得十分厌烦。

entries.example: If I tell him, then it's as good as done. He'll definitely take care of it.
entries.translation: 只要我告诉他，那就等于已经办好了。他肯定会处理好的。

entries.example: After the long hike, I was all in and could barely walk.
entries.translation: 长途徒步之后，我筋疲力尽，几乎走不动了。

entries.example: I'll call you first thing tomorrow morning to confirm the meeting.
entries.translation: 我明天一早给你打电话确认会议。

entries.example: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
entries.translation: 宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。

entries.example: I have a great deal to do today.
entries.translation: 我今天有很多事要做。

entries.example: William is so organized. He's always on top of things.
entries.translation: 威廉做事很有条理，他总是能把一切掌控好。

entries.example: What's more, you can only buy train tickets one week in advance.
entries.translation: 再说，你只能提前一周买火车票。

entries.example: She was clearly in pain after the fall, but she refused to see a doctor.
entries.translation: 摔倒后她显然很疼，却不肯去看医生。

entries.example: Workaholics view holidays as a waste of time.
entries.translation: 工作狂把假期看作浪费时间。

entries.example: I tried in vain to deal with the problem.
entries.translation: 我想解决这个问题，可是白费功夫。

entries.example: There was a sense of excitement in the air before the concert.
entries.translation: 音乐会开始前，空气中弥漫着兴奋的气氛。

entries.example: I am fed up with this wet weather.
entries.translation: 我受够了这种阴雨天气。

entries.example: If you are done with that book, I'd like to have it.
entries.translation: 如果你用完了那本书，我想借来看。

entries.example: I advertised my car for sale.
entries.translation: 我登广告出售我的车。

entries.example: It took a long time for me to get accustomed to the Venezuelan accent.
entries.translation: 我花了好长时间才适应委内瑞拉口音。

entries.example: I thought he loved you, but as it is, he loved another girl.
entries.translation: 我以为他爱你，但事实上，他爱的是另一个女孩。

entries.example: We're friends from way back.
entries.translation: 我们是老朋友。

entries.example: The whole company stood in silence for a few moments, as a tribute to the dead.
entries.translation: 全公司的人默默站立了片刻，以悼念死者。

entries.example: I would rather stay at home than go out in this hot weather.
entries.translation: 在这种大热天里，我宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。

entries.example: I have too many things on my mind these days.
entries.translation: 这些天我心里装的事情太多了。

entries.example: I am all alone in a foreign country.
entries.translation: 我独自一人在异国他乡。

entries.example: He still comes to visit me from time to time.
entries.translation: 他仍然时不时来看我。

entries.example: I don't like to go out after dark.
entries.translation: 我不喜欢天黑后出门。

entries.example: I can't do two things at a time.
entries.translation: 我不能一心二用。

entries.example: He read a book quietly, as though nothing had happened.
entries.translation: 他安静地读着书，仿佛什么事都没发生过。

entries.example: You can have this watch for nothing.
entries.translation: 你可以免费得到这块手表。

entries.example: He is anything but a gentleman.
entries.translation: 他绝不是绅士。

entries.example: Apart from languages, I'm also interested in technology.
entries.translation: 除了语言，我也对技术感兴趣。

entries.example: He started learning English at the age of eleven.
entries.translation: 他十一岁时开始学英语。

entries.example: My uncle kept on drinking in spite of his doctor's advice.
entries.translation: 我叔叔不顾医生劝阻，还是继续喝酒。

entries.example: She has decided to live in America for good.
entries.translation: 她决定永远住在美国。

entries.example: How come you didn't call me last night?
entries.translation: 你昨晚怎么没给我打电话？

entries.example: I felt out of it at the party because I didn't know anyone.
entries.translation: 在聚会上我感到格格不入，因为谁也不认识。

entries.example: It won't be a big deal if you put off buying it for a day!
entries.translation: 如果你推迟一天再买，也不会有什么大不了的！

entries.example: His political career is done for.
entries.translation: 他的政治生涯完蛋了。

entries.example: The bridge will be completed by the end of this year.
entries.translation: 这座桥将在今年年底前完工。

entries.example: She had left the company long before I joined it.
entries.translation: 我进这家公司很久以前，她就已经离开了。

entries.example: The plane had five hundred passengers on board.
entries.translation: 飞机上有五百名乘客。

entries.example: We could stay in Boston for a few more days if you like.
entries.translation: 如果你愿意的话，我们可以在波士顿多待几天。

entries.example: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
entries.translation: 在我看来，汽车弊大于利。

entries.meaning: 小菜一碟，轻而易举的事
entries.example: The exam was a piece of cake; I finished it in half an hour.
entries.translation: 这次考试轻而易举，我半个小时就做完了。

entries.example: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
entries.translation: 我们该买台新微波炉了。

entries.example: Have you been working as a doctor for long?
entries.translation: 你当医生很久了吗？

entries.example: Could you lend me some money? I'm short of cash at the moment.
entries.translation: 可以借点钱给我吗？我现在有点缺钱。

entries.example: It's no good trying to persuade her.
entries.translation: 试图劝她是没有用的。

entries.example: Admitting what you say, I still think you are in the wrong.
entries.translation: 虽然我承认你说的，但我仍然认为你是错的。

entries.example: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
entries.translation: 她因为担心发胖而节食。

entries.example: For some reason, I feel sleepy when I start studying.
entries.translation: 不知道为什么，我一开始学习就犯困。

entries.example: The first time, I spoke pretty much no Chinese at all, and didn't understand China's conventions and customs.
entries.translation: 第一次，我几乎完全不会说中文，也不了解中国的惯例和习俗。

entries.example: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.
entries.translation: 有时候，我们应该退后一步想一想。

entries.example: The situation hasn't improved; if anything, it has got worse.
entries.translation: 情况没有好转；如果说有变化，反倒更糟了。

entries.example: The Japanese at large consider themselves better off than they used to be.
entries.translation: 日本人普遍觉得自己比以前过得好。

entries.example: There on the top of a high mountain they built a small town of their own and lived in peace.
entries.translation: 他们在高山顶上建了一座属于自己的小城镇，并在那里安宁地生活。

entries.example: He likes to go to the beach now and then.
entries.translation: 他喜欢偶尔去海边。

entries.example: I don't know about the others, but as for me, I'm for it.
entries.translation: 我不知道别人怎么想，至于我，我是支持的。

entries.example: On the whole, I am in favor of your opinion.
entries.translation: 总的来说，我赞成你的意见。

entries.example: The mountains were all around the city.
entries.translation: 群山环绕着这座城市。

entries.example: Autumn is just around the corner.
entries.translation: 秋天马上就要到了。

entries.example: Tom might be here by 2:30, but then, maybe not.
entries.translation: 汤姆两点半可能会到，不过，也可能不会。

entries.example: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
entries.translation: 请把椅子拿走，它挡着道了。

entries.example: It's not a big deal. Don't worry about it.
entries.translation: 这没什么大不了的，别担心。

entries.example: Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
entries.translation: 最重要的是，你要好好照顾自己。

entries.example: This store has a variety of spices.
entries.translation: 这家商店有各种香料。

entries.example: His speech was short and to the point.
entries.translation: 他的演讲简短且切中要害。

entries.example: He read the letter over and over.
entries.translation: 他把信读了一遍又一遍。

entries.example: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
entries.translation: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。

entries.example: The old man got in her way.
entries.translation: 那位老人挡住了她的路。

entries.example: Things are getting out of control.
entries.translation: 事情快要失控了。

entries.example: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
entries.translation: 他惊讶地发现，那位大画家的杰作竟然被上下颠倒地挂在墙上。

entries.example: At times the train doesn't arrive on time.
entries.translation: 有时候火车没能按时到达。

entries.example: She goes to the library every other day.
entries.translation: 她每隔一天去一次图书馆。

entries.example: After hiking all day, I felt completely done in.
entries.translation: 徒步了一整天后，我觉得筋疲力尽。

entries.example: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
entries.translation: 患难见真情。

entries.example: He was banned from driving for life after the accident.
entries.translation: 事故之后他被终身禁止开车。

entries.example: I took your umbrella by mistake.
entries.translation: 我错拿了你的雨伞。

entries.example: You're wearing your sweater inside out.
entries.translation: 你的毛衣穿反了。

entries.example: I'll never ever do that again!
entries.translation: 我再也不会那样做了！

entries.example: The letter will arrive in a week or so.
entries.translation: 这封信大约一个星期左右到达。

entries.example: Your report is pretty good, if not excellent.
entries.translation: 你的报告相当不错，甚至可以说很出色。

entries.example: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
entries.translation: 水果富含维生素和矿物质。

entries.example: It's written in black and white. How can you be in doubt?
entries.translation: 这是白纸黑字写着的，你怎么还怀疑？

entries.example: She teaches English at a school and writes children's books on the side.
entries.translation: 她在学校教英语，业余还写儿童书。

entries.example: She had no difficulty in learning the poem by heart.
entries.translation: 她毫不费力就把这首诗背下来了。

entries.example: You passed the exam? Good for you. I knew you could do it.
entries.translation: 你考试通过了？真棒，我就知道你能做到。

entries.example: Why is everyone being so nice to me all of a sudden?
entries.translation: 为什么大家突然对我这么好？

entries.example: I met him on the street by chance after many years.
entries.translation: 多年后我在街上偶遇了他。

entries.example: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.
entries.translation: 大热天喝杯冰啤酒，真是再好不过了。

entries.example: But earthquakes are still as frightening as ever.
entries.translation: 但地震仍然和以往一样可怕。

entries.example: Please move out of the way so this lady can go through.
entries.translation: 请让开，好让这位女士过去。

entries.example: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
entries.translation: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

entries.example: They usually use an anchor to hold a yacht in place.
entries.translation: 他们通常用锚把游艇固定在原位。

entries.example: I'll be on my feet tomorrow.
entries.translation: 我明天就能下床走动了。

entries.meaning: 随着时间的推移，渐渐地
entries.example: At first, we weren't familiar at all. Over time we got to know each other.
entries.translation: 起初我们一点也不熟，渐渐地就互相了解了。

entries.example: More than half of the residents are opposed to the plan.
entries.translation: 超过半数的居民反对这个计划。

entries.example: The prisoner was behind bars for two months.
entries.translation: 那名囚犯在狱中待了两个月。

entries.example: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
entries.translation: 我想特别强调这一点。

entries.example: These problems will be solved in the near future.
entries.translation: 这些问题在不久的将来就会得到解决。

entries.example: He received quite a few letters this morning.
entries.translation: 今天早上他收到了不少信。

entries.example: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
entries.translation: 我突然想大声喊出来。

entries.example: The sky cleared up soon after the storm.
entries.translation: 暴风雨过后不久，天空就放晴了。

entries.example: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.
entries.translation: 一英里大约等于1600米。

entries.example: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.
entries.translation: 你与其盯着天花板发呆，倒不如读本小说。

entries.example: We have to do a great deal of reading.
entries.translation: 我们要读很多书。

entries.example: Why don't you stay a little while?
entries.translation: 你为什么不留下来待一会儿呢？

entries.example: All sorts of people live in Tokyo.
entries.translation: 东京住着形形色色的人。

entries.example: Like any company, we've got to look ahead and plan for the future.
entries.translation: 和其他公司一样，我们必须向前看，为未来做规划。

entries.example: She sent the report, together with a short summary, to the manager.
entries.translation: 她把报告连同一份简短的摘要一起发给了经理。

entries.example: The staff in this shop are really friendly; no wonder they've got so many customers.
entries.translation: 这家商店的员工非常友好，难怪他们有这么多顾客。

entries.example: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.
entries.translation: 她找不到合适的语言来表达自己的感受。

entries.example: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
entries.translation: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。

entries.example: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
entries.translation: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。

entries.example: I recognised her straight away; she hasn't changed a bit.
entries.translation: 我一下子就认出她了，她一点儿都没变。

entries.example: When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
entries.translation: 当我说中文时，我开始感到自在了。

entries.example: I would prefer to speak to you in private.
entries.translation: 我更想和你私下谈谈。

entries.example: What he said was over my head.
entries.translation: 他说的话我完全听不懂。

entries.example: I gave her a doll in return.
entries.translation: 作为回报，我给了她一个娃娃。

entries.example: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
entries.translation: 大家都反对，但他们还是结婚了。

entries.example: Is there a discount if you pay in cash?
entries.translation: 如果用现金付款，有折扣吗？

entries.example: Despite the fact that he has only just started learning Chinese, he already knows lots of characters.
entries.translation: 尽管他才刚开始学中文，却已经认识很多汉字了。

entries.example: I arrived at the village before dark.
entries.translation: 我在天黑前到达了村庄。

entries.example: It took me by surprise to hear that Carl was moving to Germany.
entries.translation: 听说卡尔要搬到德国去，这让我很吃惊。

entries.example: Our plan went wrong from the beginning.
entries.translation: 我们的计划从一开始就出错了。

entries.example: Success is always on the side of the persevering.
entries.translation: 成功总是站在坚持不懈的人一边。

entries.example: The small village lies about ten miles south of the city.
entries.translation: 这个小村庄位于该市以南约十英里处。

entries.example: There was no point in arguing with her at this point.
entries.translation: 事到如今，也没有和她争吵的必要了。

entries.example: Our lives have changed for ever.
entries.translation: 我们的生活永远地改变了。

entries.example: It was not until three days after that I knew she had disappeared.
entries.translation: 他直到三十岁才开始画画。

entries.example: The quality of their products has gone down over the years.
entries.translation: 多年来，他们产品的质量一直在下降。

entries.example: What's up? Why are you sad?
entries.translation: 怎么了？你为什么伤心？

entries.example: Who cares when she will marry?
entries.translation: 谁管她什么时候结婚？

entries.example: You're not even fazed. You must have known all along!
entries.translation: 你一点也不惊讶，你肯定一直都知道。

entries.example: I bought a set of brand new speakers.
entries.translation: 我买了一套全新的音响。

entries.example: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
entries.translation: 你烟抽得太多了，应该少抽一点。

entries.example: I'm afraid this job is too much for you.
entries.translation: 恐怕这份工作对你来说太难了。

entries.example: There wasn't a soul in sight.
entries.translation: 一个人影也看不到。

entries.example: Hearing the sad news, she collapsed in tears.
entries.translation: 听到这个悲伤的消息，她泣不成声。

entries.example: All this is new to me.
entries.translation: 这一切对我来说都是陌生的。

entries.example: You'll get used to living here in no time.
entries.translation: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。

entries.example: The elevator seems to be out of order.
entries.translation: 电梯好像出故障了。

entries.example: They have been good neighbors to this day.
entries.translation: 他们至今一直是好邻居。

entries.example: He thinks I don't know anything about it, but, in reality, I know everything.
entries.translation: 他以为我什么都不知道，其实我什么都知道。

entries.example: So much for the introductions; let's move on to the main issues.
entries.translation: 介绍就到此为止；我们接着讨论主要问题吧。

entries.example: I do not know for certain when he will come.
entries.translation: 我不确定他什么时候来。

entries.example: I can pay no more than $50 a week for rent.
entries.translation: 我每周最多只能付50美元的房租。

entries.example: He is superior to me in English.
entries.translation: 他的英语比我好。

entries.example: Please pay the amount in full before the end of the month.
entries.translation: 请在月底前全额支付这笔款项。

entries.example: He succeeded in the face of great difficulties.
entries.translation: 面对巨大的困难，他成功了。

entries.example: He is by nature a kind person and is popular with the children in his neighborhood.
entries.translation: 他天生就是个和蔼可亲的人，很受附近孩子们的欢迎。

entries.example: I am staying at the hotel for the time being.
entries.translation: 我暂时住在这家酒店。

entries.example: It snowed for ten days in a row.
entries.translation: 一连下了十天雪。

entries.example: In Japan, it rains quite a bit during our rainy season which is from mid-June until mid-July.
entries.translation: 在日本，六月中旬到七月中旬是雨季，这段时间经常下雨。

entries.example: My father has never been outside the country until now.
entries.translation: 在此之前，我父亲从未出过国。

entries.example: After months of practice, the driving test was a piece of cake for her.
entries.translation: 练了几个月之后，驾照考试对她来说就是小菜一碟。

entries.example: Everyone was more or less interested in the arts.
entries.translation: 每个人都或多或少对艺术感兴趣。

entries.example: Now that you have come of age, you should be responsible for what you do.
entries.translation: 既然你已经成年了，就应该对自己的行为负责。

entries.example: Say it to his face, not behind his back.
entries.translation: 当面跟他说，不要背后说。

entries.example: Your proposal is worthy of being considered.
entries.translation: 你的提议值得考虑。

entries.example: The boy was accompanied by his parents.
entries.translation: 那个男孩由他的父母陪同。

entries.example: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
entries.translation: 水果富含维生素和矿物质。

entries.example: People look at things differently depending on whether they are rich or poor.
entries.translation: 人们看待事物的角度不同，取决于他们是富有还是贫穷。

entries.example: I went into the town in search of a good restaurant.
entries.translation: 我进城去找一家好餐馆。

entries.example: As always, I could only hope the police wouldn't stop me.
entries.translation: 和往常一样，我只能希望警察不会拦下我。

entries.example: I would be grateful for any help you could give me.
entries.translation: 如果您能给我任何帮助，我将不胜感激。

entries.example: The population of the world will double before long.
entries.translation: 世界人口不久后将翻一番。

entries.example: Like it or not, we have to attend that meeting.
entries.translation: 不管喜不喜欢，我们都得参加那个会议。

entries.example: Anyone breaking the rules will be asked to leave on the spot.
entries.translation: 任何违反规定的人都会被当场要求离开。

entries.example: Speaking without thinking is like shooting without looking.
entries.translation: 说话不假思索，就像射击不看目标。

entries.example: Once upon a time, there was an old man in this village.
entries.translation: 从前，这个村子里有一位老人。

entries.example: Teachers must be tired of correcting the same mistakes over and over again in their students' papers.
entries.translation: 老师肯定厌倦了一遍又一遍地纠正学生试卷中同样的错误。

entries.example: Many archeological sites are at risk due to poor maintenance.
entries.translation: 由于维护不善，许多考古遗址正处于危险之中。

entries.example: I'm by no means angry with you.
entries.translation: 我绝对没有生你的气。

entries.example: He sleeps by day and works by night.
entries.translation: 他白天睡觉，晚上工作。

entries.example: If you work day and night, you will lose your health.
entries.translation: 如果你不分昼夜地工作，就会损害健康。

entries.example: Even with all the money he has, he isn't happy.
entries.translation: 尽管他有那么多钱，他并不快乐。

entries.example: He cannot afford to buy a car, much less a house.
entries.translation: 他买不起一辆汽车，更不要说一套房子了。

entries.example: Why does the phone have to ring all the time only when I'm busy? I can't get any work done because of it.
entries.translation: 为什么电话总是在我忙的时候响？我都没法干活了。

entries.example: She began to cry at the sight of my face.
entries.translation: 她一看到我的脸就开始哭。

entries.example: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.
entries.translation: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。

entries.example: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.
entries.translation: 只有努力学习，你才能考上大学。

entries.example: Most of the time, he doesn't get to sleep before two or even three o'clock in the morning.
entries.translation: 大多数时候，他要到凌晨两三点才能入睡。

entries.example: You've only been on the job for about 15 minutes.
entries.translation: 你上班才大约十五分钟。

entries.example: John should be here any minute now.
entries.translation: 约翰现在随时都可能到这里。

entries.example: All students of English should have a good English-English dictionary at hand.
entries.translation: 所有学英语的学生都应当手边备一本好的英英词典。

entries.example: You ought to walk a mile in his shoes before you criticize him.
entries.translation: 在批评他之前，你应当先设身处地为他想想。

entries.example: Ten minutes later, our car ran out of gas.
entries.translation: 十分钟后，我们的车没油了。

entries.example: Anything you say can be used against you in court.
entries.translation: 你在法庭上说的任何话都可能被用来对你不利。

entries.example: I bought this T-shirt on sale.
entries.translation: 我买了这件打折的T恤。

entries.example: We took a taxi so as to reach there on time.
entries.translation: 为了准时到达那里，我们叫了出租车。

entries.example: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
entries.translation: 我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。

entries.example: I have a lot in common with her.
entries.translation: 我和她有很多共同点。

entries.example: How about eating out this evening for a change?
entries.translation: 今晚换换口味出去吃怎么样？

entries.example: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
entries.translation: 事实上，我从今天早上到现在什么都没吃。

entries.example: The movie was so dull that the audience left one by one.
entries.translation: 这部电影太无聊了，观众一个个地离开了。

entries.example: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
entries.translation: 跑上山后，我完全喘不过气来。

entries.example: We have to bring our teaching methods up to date.
entries.translation: 我们必须使教学方法与时俱进。

entries.example: I've told you again and again to be more careful.
entries.translation: 我已再三告诉你要更小心。

entries.example: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
entries.translation: 春节也被称为农历新年。

entries.example: We all make mistakes at some point in our lives.
entries.translation: 我们每个人在人生的某个阶段都会犯错。

entries.example: It is not my intent to hurt you in any way.
entries.translation: 我无意以任何方式伤害你。

entries.example: Things that you see with your eyes are not necessarily true.
entries.translation: 你亲眼看到的事情未必是真的。

entries.example: After paying the rent, I was completely out of money.
entries.translation: 付完房租后，我彻底没钱了。

entries.example: We went all out to get the job done.
entries.translation: 我们全力以赴完成了这项工作。

entries.example: Buying such an expensive car is out of the question.
entries.translation: 买这么贵的车根本不可能。

entries.example: I learned Spanish from scratch at university.
entries.translation: 我在大学从零开始学西班牙语。

entries.example: Watch your step, or else you will trip on the baggage.
entries.translation: 走路小心，否则你会被行李绊倒。

entries.example: Her skin was white as milk and she had not a single blemish anywhere.
entries.translation: 她的肌肤白如牛奶，身上没有一处斑点。

entries.example: It's not all that uncommon for people to live past the age of ninety.
entries.translation: 人们活过九十岁并不那么罕见。

entries.example: In a way you are right, but I still have doubts.
entries.translation: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。

entries.example: There's a lot of money at stake in this transaction.
entries.translation: 这笔交易中有很多钱面临风险。

entries.example: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
entries.translation: 好久不见了。你还记得我上次见你是什么时候吗？

entries.example: Industrialization often goes hand in hand with pollution.
entries.translation: 工业化常常与污染相伴而生。

entries.example: I'm in debt to my uncle for $10,000.
entries.translation: 我欠叔叔一万美元。

entries.example: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
entries.translation: 我们罢工是因为公司没有提高我们的工资。

entries.example: Wow, I can't believe they actually met the deadline for once.
entries.translation: 哇，真不敢相信他们这次居然真的赶上截止日期了。

entries.example: I think this machine is in need of repair.
entries.translation: 我觉得这台机器需要修理。

entries.example: The doctor advised me to take up some sport to stay in shape.
entries.translation: 医生建议我参加一些运动来保持身材。

entries.example: I'm in the mood for something sweet.
entries.translation: 我现在想吃点甜的东西。

entries.example: She was on edge till she heard from her husband.
entries.translation: 她一直心神不宁，直到收到丈夫的音信。

entries.example: When the breaker tripped and it became pitch black, the baby got scared and started crying.
entries.translation: 断路器跳闸后四周一片漆黑，宝宝吓得哭了起来。

entries.example: It is true the boy is mischievous, but he is kind at heart.
entries.translation: 这男孩确实淘气，但内心很善良。

entries.example: She solved the problem with ease.
entries.translation: 她不费吹灰之力就把问题解决了。

entries.example: We were out of time, so we had to stop the discussion.
entries.translation: 我们没时间了，只好停止讨论。

entries.example: The train arrived ten minutes behind schedule.
entries.translation: 火车比预定时间晚十分钟到达。

entries.example: It all turned out for the best in the end.
entries.translation: 最后结果一切都很好。

entries.example: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
entries.translation: 无论何时都要系好安全带。

entries.example: The tree was ready to fall at any moment.
entries.translation: 那棵树随时会倒下来。

entries.example: Every now and then he drops in at this bookstore on his way home from the office.
entries.translation: 有时从办公室回家的路上，他会到这家书店看一看。

entries.example: I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
entries.translation: 如果可能的话，我想去世界各地旅行。

entries.example: The plane took off and was soon out of sight.
entries.translation: 飞机起飞后，很快就消失在视线之外。

entries.example: Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
entries.translation: 几艘游艇在远方的海面上并排航行。

entries.example: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.
entries.translation: 你不该未经允许就看别人的私人信件。

entries.example: In the long run, we can save a lot of money by buying this machine.
entries.translation: 长远来看，买这台机器我们能省下很多钱。

entries.example: The man who lives next door to us is a famous actor.
entries.translation: 住在我们隔壁的男人是位知名演员。

entries.example: Only a handful of people know the fact.
entries.translation: 只有少数人知道这个事实。

entries.example: Interest on loans is high at present.
entries.translation: 现在的贷款利率很高。

entries.example: There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
entries.translation: 山脚下有一座古老的城堡。

entries.example: She goes to the library every other day.
entries.translation: 她每隔一天去图书馆。

entries.example: Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
entries.translation: 几艘游艇在远处的海面上并排航行。

entries.example: He has been devoted to the study of atomic energy ever since he graduated from the university.
entries.translation: 自从大学毕业后，他就一直致力于原子能的研究。

entries.example: Seen from a distance, the stone looks like a human face.
entries.translation: 从远处看，这块石头像一张人脸。

entries.example: I'll be ready in a moment.
entries.translation: 我马上就准备好。

entries.example: He opened the bank account in the name of his daughter.
entries.translation: 他以女儿的名义开了这个银行账户。

entries.example: You'd better take your umbrella, just in case it rains.
entries.translation: 你最好带上雨伞，以防下雨。

entries.example: Mike has been out of work for a year.
entries.translation: 迈克已经失业一年了。

entries.example: I will stand by you whatever happens.
entries.translation: 不论发生什么事，我都会在你身边。

entries.example: Our plans fell through at the last minute.
entries.translation: 我们的计划在最后一刻失败了。

entries.example: Banks across the country had closed their doors.
entries.translation: 全国各地的银行都关门了。

entries.example: Your face is familiar to me.
entries.translation: 你的脸对我来说很熟悉。

entries.example: He was born so poor that he received hardly any school education.
entries.translation: 他出身贫寒，几乎没受过什么学校教育。

entries.example: I'm working like crazy to make sure I have enough time.
entries.translation: 我正在拼命工作，以确保有足够的时间。

entries.example: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
entries.translation: 无论发生什么，我都不会改变主意。

entries.example: He's either crazy or on drugs.
entries.translation: 他要么是疯了，要么是吸毒了。

entries.example: Among the five of us, she, without a doubt, speaks the most languages.
entries.translation: 在我们五个人当中，她无疑会说的语言最多。

entries.example: I'm tied up in meetings all afternoon, so let's talk tomorrow.
entries.translation: 我整个下午都忙着开会脱不开身，我们明天再谈吧。

entries.example: Do you work well under pressure?
entries.translation: 你在压力下工作表现好吗？

entries.example: In the matter of food and clothing, we are pretty well off.
entries.translation: 在衣食方面，我们相当宽裕。

entries.example: There is a post office close by.
entries.translation: 附近有一家邮局。

entries.example: I'm not in control of the situation. Nothing is happening the way I expected.
entries.translation: 我控制不了局面。事情都没有按我预期的那样发展。

entries.example: She is shy and always remains in the background.
entries.translation: 她很害羞，总是保持低调。

entries.example: With her help, my French improved little by little.
entries.translation: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。

entries.example: So far as I know, he is an honest man.
entries.translation: 据我所知，他是一个诚实的人。

entries.example: He fell in love with her at first sight.
entries.translation: 他对她一见钟情。

entries.example: After hiking all day, we were all in and went straight to bed.
entries.translation: 徒步了一整天后，我们精疲力竭，直接上床睡觉了。

entries.example: I am not in the least afraid of dogs.
entries.translation: 我一点也不怕狗。

entries.example: After she had read the letter, she tore it to pieces.
entries.translation: 她读完信后，把它撕成了碎片。

entries.example: Economic conditions are in a state of flux.
entries.translation: 经济状况处于不断变化之中。

entries.example: I am in the habit of taking a shower in the morning.
entries.translation: 我习惯早上洗澡。

entries.example: In this case, I think he is correct.
entries.translation: 这样的话，我想他是对的。

entries.example: Who is the greatest composer of all time?
entries.translation: 谁是有史以来最伟大的作曲家？

entries.example: The translation is quite true to the original.
entries.translation: 这篇翻译相当忠实于原文。

entries.example: Doctors and nurses must preserve life at all costs.
entries.translation: 医生和护士必须不惜一切代价挽救生命。

entries.example: Have you been in contact with him recently?
entries.translation: 你最近和他有联系吗？

entries.example: At one time they lived in Nagoya.
entries.translation: 他们曾经在名古屋住过一段时间。

entries.example: They must have arrived home by this time.
entries.translation: 他们这个时候一定已经到家了。

entries.example: I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.
entries.translation: 我完全不赞同你的方法。

entries.example: "What are you doing here?" he asked me in surprise.
entries.translation: “你在这里做什么？”他惊讶地问我。

entries.example: Many flights were canceled, owing to the typhoon.
entries.translation: 由于台风，很多航班被取消了。

entries.example: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
entries.translation: 这些纸板盒是百分之百可回收的。

entries.example: He presented me with a bouquet of flowers.
entries.translation: 他送给我一束花。

entries.example: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
entries.translation: 突然间，她开始用尖利的声音大喊。

entries.example: Demand for imported cars is increasing due to lower prices.
entries.translation: 由于价格下降，对进口汽车的需求正在增长。

entries.example: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.
entries.translation: 婴儿在母亲怀里睡得很熟。

entries.example: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
entries.translation: 那座老桥有坍塌的危险。

entries.example: It rained on and off all day.
entries.translation: 雨断断续续地下了一整天。

entries.example: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.
entries.translation: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。

entries.example: With the help of doctors, she got over her illness.
entries.translation: 在医生的帮助下，她痊愈了。

entries.example: What is he so angry about?
entries.translation: 他为什么这么生气？

entries.example: The weather is getting colder day by day.
entries.translation: 天气一天天冷下来了。

entries.example: We looked for it here and there.
entries.translation: 我们到处找它。

entries.example: The couple have no less than seven children.
entries.translation: 这对夫妇有七个子女之多。

entries.example: Your analysis of the problem was spot on.
entries.translation: 你对这个问题的分析完全正确。

entries.example: Some people seem to always want to have the last word.
entries.translation: 有些人似乎总想拥有最后发言权。

entries.example: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
entries.translation: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。

entries.example: I'll help you with pleasure if you want me to.
entries.translation: 如果你要我帮忙，我会很乐意。

entries.example: We flew from New York to St. Louis by way of Chicago.
entries.translation: 我们从纽约经芝加哥飞往圣路易斯。

entries.example: It's already eleven. It's high time you were in bed.
entries.translation: 已经十一点了。你早该睡觉了。

entries.example: The police have one of the kidnappers in custody.
entries.translation: 警方已经拘留了其中一名绑匪。

entries.example: Do you have any idea how hard I tried to get you back on track?
entries.translation: 你知道我费了多大劲才让你回到正轨吗？

entries.example: Stop getting yourself worked up over little things.
entries.translation: 别因为一些小事就让自己烦躁不安。

entries.example: She is married to an English teacher, so she can take lessons free of charge.
entries.translation: 她嫁给了一位英语老师，所以能免费上课。

entries.example: Oh, take your time. I'm in no hurry.
entries.translation: 哦，慢慢来。我不着急。

entries.example: I'll come and see you one of these days.
entries.translation: 我改天会来看你的。

entries.example: She looks happy, but deep down, she suffers.
entries.translation: 她看上去很快乐，但内心深处却很痛苦。

entries.example: I don't think she is fit for the job.
entries.translation: 我认为她不适合这份工作。

entries.example: He is used to eating in a rush.
entries.translation: 他习惯匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

entries.example: I feel at peace with myself now.
entries.translation: 我现在内心感到平静安宁。

entries.example: The two countries have been at war for over ten years.
entries.translation: 这两个国家已经交战十多年了。

entries.example: These are the best bags on the market.
entries.translation: 这些是市面上最好的包。

entries.example: He just drones on and on but hardly even touches on what we need to know for the test.
entries.translation: 他没完没了地絮叨，却几乎没涉及考试需要我们掌握的内容。

entries.example: On average, I watch two films a month.
entries.translation: 我平均每个月看两部电影。

entries.example: Summer arrived in June, right on schedule.
entries.translation: 夏天在六月如期而至。

entries.example: The houses caught fire one after another.
entries.translation: 那些房子一栋接一栋地着了火。

entries.example: Up to now, I've met him only once.
entries.translation: 到目前为止，我只见过他一次。

entries.example: This soup needs just a touch of salt.
entries.translation: 这汤只需要加一点点盐。

entries.example: Boys, as a rule, are taller than girls.
entries.translation: 一般来说，男孩比女孩高一些。

entries.example: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.
entries.translation: 听众中有学生、老师，还有职员，等等。

entries.example: I know him by name, but not by sight.
entries.translation: 我知道他的名字，但没见过他本人。

entries.example: Those under arrest were waiting to be questioned.
entries.translation: 那些被捕的人正在等待接受审问。

entries.example: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
entries.translation: 这些学生大部分来自西海岸。

entries.example: If it were not for water, no one could live on earth.
entries.translation: 如果没有水，没有人能在地球上生存。

entries.example: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
entries.translation: 越来越多的女性拥有自己的事业，在经济上不依赖丈夫。

entries.example: His business plan looks good on paper but I get the feeling it would never work in practice.
entries.translation: 他的商业计划在理论上看起来不错，但我总觉得实际操作中根本行不通。

entries.example: He chose every word with care.
entries.translation: 他每选一个词都很仔细。

entries.example: High-rises are going up all over the place.
entries.translation: 高楼大厦正在到处拔地而起。

entries.example: "May I use your telephone?" "By all means."
entries.translation: “我能用一下你的电话吗？”“当然可以。”

entries.example: If I go to China, it'd be to speak Chinese as much as possible.
entries.translation: 如果我去中国，那就是为了尽可能多地说中文。

entries.example: The cherry blossoms are at their best.
entries.translation: 樱花正处于最美的时节。

entries.example: At the time of the accident, almost all of the passengers on the bus were sleeping.
entries.translation: 事故发生时，公交车上几乎所有乘客都在睡觉。

entries.example: When you decide which plan you want, please notify us in writing.
entries.translation: 当你决定想要哪个计划时，请书面通知我们。

entries.example: On the contrary, I've never said such a thing.
entries.translation: 恰恰相反，我从没说过这样的话。

entries.example: A sudden storm came out of nowhere and ruined our picnic.
entries.translation: 一场暴风雨突然袭来，毁了我们的野餐。

entries.example: This large sofa would be out of place in a small room.
entries.translation: 这张大沙发放在小房间里会显得不协调。

entries.example: I will lend you any book that I have, so long as you keep it clean.
entries.translation: 我的书每一本都可以借给你，只要你不把它们弄脏就行了。

entries.example: She made the same mistake as before.
entries.translation: 她犯了和以前同样的错误。

entries.example: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
entries.translation: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。

entries.example: These goods were imported from abroad in secret.
entries.translation: 这些货物是秘密从国外进口的。

entries.example: A good idea occurred to me just then.
entries.translation: 就在那时，我想到了一个好主意。

entries.example: The football game is now on the air.
entries.translation: 电视台现在正在播放足球赛。

entries.example: Recently juvenile delinquency has been on the rise.
entries.translation: 最近青少年犯罪率一直在上升。

entries.example: She was very pleased when her son returned home safe and sound.
entries.translation: 儿子安然无恙地回到家，她非常高兴。

entries.example: You're sad now but, with time, you'll get over it.
entries.translation: 你现在很难过，但随着时间的推移，你会走出来的。

entries.example: At any rate, we have no means of helping him.
entries.translation: 无论如何，我们也帮不了他。

entries.example: I have nothing to tell you for the moment.
entries.translation: 我暂时没有什么要告诉你的。

entries.example: She turned away in horror at the sight of blood.
entries.translation: 看到血，她惊恐地转过身去。

entries.example: It looks like the party in power will win the upcoming election.
entries.translation: 看起来执政党会赢得即将到来的选举。

entries.example: The castle has been restored and is open to the public.
entries.translation: 这座城堡已经修复，并对公众开放。

entries.example: I can't sleep when I'm stressed out.
entries.translation: 我压力大时就睡不着觉。

entries.example: A great many students were absent from school.
entries.translation: 有好多学生都没来学校。

entries.example: My house is a long way from here.
entries.translation: 我家离这儿很远。

entries.example: Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.
entries.translation: 往返各目的地的票价如下。

entries.example: The word is no longer in use.
entries.translation: 这个词现在不用了。

entries.example: If you are tied up now, I'll call you back later on.
entries.translation: 如果你现在忙得脱不开身，我稍后再打给你。

entries.example: Aside from his salary, he receives money from investments.
entries.translation: 除了工资以外，他还有投资方面的收入。

entries.example: He banged the door in anger.
entries.translation: 他气愤地摔上了门。

entries.example: This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.
entries.translation: 我这趟旅程一共需要十二天。

entries.example: We're in the process of writing the report now.
entries.translation: 我们现在正在写这份报告。

entries.example: I'm on good terms with the neighbors.
entries.translation: 我和邻居们关系很好。

entries.example: The patient is out of danger now.
entries.translation: 病人现在已经脱离危险了。

entries.example: The chairman resigned out of the blue.
entries.translation: 董事长突然辞职了。

entries.example: My bicycle disappeared into thin air.
entries.translation: 我的自行车消失得无影无踪。

entries.example: For some reason, I'm wide awake and can't fall asleep.
entries.translation: 不知为什么，我毫无睡意，怎么也睡不着。

entries.example: You must hand in your homework by Thursday without fail.
entries.translation: 你务必在周四之前把作业交上来。

entries.example: I like English best of all subjects.
entries.translation: 在所有科目中，我最喜欢英语。

entries.example: We will move into our new house next month if it is completed by then.
entries.translation: 如果到那时房子能完工，我们下个月就搬进新家。

entries.example: I left the window open all through the night.
entries.translation: 我让窗户开了一整夜。

entries.example: He boarded a plane bound for Los Angeles.
entries.translation: 他登上了飞往洛杉矶的飞机。

entries.example: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
entries.translation: 自从手术后，我父亲的身体状况一直很好。

entries.example: In that case we should start by having a family meeting.
entries.translation: 那样的话，我们应该先开一次家庭会议。

entries.example: They decided to hold the wedding ceremony in the open.
entries.translation: 他们决定在露天举行婚礼。

entries.example: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
entries.translation: 请代我向你的家人问好。

entries.example: On the surface he seemed calm, but inside he was extremely nervous.
entries.translation: 表面上他看起来很平静，但内心极度紧张。

entries.example: Speaking of traffic accidents, I saw one last year.
entries.translation: 说起交通事故，我去年就见过一起。

entries.example: Some people seem to always want to have the last word.
entries.translation: 有些人似乎总想在争论中说最后一句话。

entries.example: Come here by ten at the latest.
entries.translation: 最晚十点到这里来。

entries.example: Our success was due in part to good luck.
entries.translation: 我们的成功部分归功于好运气。

entries.example: I agree with the ban in principle, but in practice it will be extremely difficult.
entries.translation: 我原则上同意这项禁令，但实际上执行起来会极其困难。

entries.example: The subjects for the experiment were chosen at random.
entries.translation: 实验对象是随机挑选的。

entries.meaning: 不管怎样，两种情况下都
entries.example: We can meet on Friday or Saturday; either way, I'll book the table.
entries.translation: 我们可以在周五或周六见面；不管怎样，我都会订好位子。

entries.example: The huts were built with a space of 50 meters in between.
entries.translation: 这些小屋之间留有五十米的间隔。

entries.example: We've been driving in circles for an hour.
entries.translation: 我们已经开车兜了一个小时的圈子。

entries.example: This style of hat is now in fashion.
entries.translation: 这种款式的帽子现在很流行。

entries.example: The monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
entries.translation: 这座纪念碑是为纪念那位杰出的哲学家而立的。

entries.example: The escaped prisoners are still on the run.
entries.translation: 逃犯仍在逃亡。

entries.example: The group of noisy boys was getting out of hand.
entries.translation: 那群吵闹的男孩越来越难以控制。

entries.example: I hate people who make small talk in quiet public places.
entries.translation: 我讨厌在安静的公共场所闲聊的人。

entries.example: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
entries.translation: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

entries.example: The raft has drifted far off from the shore.
entries.translation: 木筏已经漂到离岸边很远的地方。

entries.example: If necessary, I have no objection to paying a special fee.
entries.translation: 如果必要的话，我不反对支付一笔特别费用。

entries.example: Do you offer a volume discount? If so, please send details.
entries.translation: 你们提供批量折扣吗？如果有的话，请把详情发给我。

entries.example: Needless to say, health is above wealth.
entries.translation: 不用说，健康比财富更重要。

entries.example: I'm feeling depressed on the inside, but you can't tell by looking, can you?
entries.translation: 我内心感到很沮丧，但从外表上看不出来，对吧？

entries.example: I'm afraid I'm a bit out of shape.
entries.translation: 恐怕我身体状态有点不佳。

entries.example: Shanghai has everything under the sun when it comes to food.
entries.translation: 说到吃的东西，上海可谓海内外什么菜肴都有。

entries.example: Are there many people in Europe who believe in ghosts even now?
entries.translation: 欧洲现在是不是还有很多人相信鬼魂？

entries.example: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
entries.translation: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

entries.example: I'm not ready to give up just yet.
entries.translation: 我还不打算放弃。

entries.example: I tried to reach him, but he was on the telephone all morning.
entries.translation: 我试着联系他，但他整个上午都在打电话。

entries.example: Rick was over the moon about passing the exam.
entries.translation: 里克因通过考试而欣喜若狂。

entries.example: Like a good wine, he improves with age.
entries.translation: 就像上好的红酒一样，他随着年龄的增长变得越来越好。

entries.example: Ken took the examination with confidence.
entries.translation: 肯满怀信心地参加了考试。

entries.example: As a treat, my parents took us out for ice cream.
entries.translation: 作为犒劳，父母带我们出去吃冰淇淋。

entries.example: A good night's sleep will do you a world of good.
entries.translation: 好好睡一觉对你大有好处。

entries.example: She needs to be the center of attention all the time.
entries.translation: 她时时刻刻都需要成为众人关注的焦点。

entries.example: When we were on the brink of starvation, they saved our lives.
entries.translation: 当我们濒临饿死时，他们救了我们的命。

entries.example: His life was full of ups and downs.
entries.translation: 他的人生充满了起起落落。

entries.example: The patient is getting worse and worse day by day.
entries.translation: 病人的病情每况愈下。

entries.example: Among other things, he has an eye for good pictures.
entries.translation: 除了别的之外，他还很会欣赏好画。

entries.example: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.
entries.translation: 从整体看，计划似乎很好。

entries.example: I was determined to fulfill my duties at any cost.
entries.translation: 我决心不惜一切代价履行我的职责。

entries.example: The company hopes to land a big fish from a rival firm next month.
entries.translation: 公司希望下个月从一家竞争对手那里挖来一位大人物。

entries.example: That young man is very keen on cycling.
entries.translation: 那个年轻人非常热衷于骑自行车。

entries.example: It's written in black and white. How can you be in doubt?
entries.translation: 这白纸黑字写着呢，你怎么还怀疑？

entries.example: There was a lot of food left over from the party.
entries.translation: 聚会剩下了很多食物。

entries.example: Long skirts are out of fashion now.
entries.translation: 长裙现在过时了。

entries.example: Is there a greetings card shop round here?
entries.translation: 这附近有贺卡店吗？

entries.example: Jim is short for James.
entries.translation: 吉姆是詹姆斯的简称。

entries.example: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.
entries.translation: 婴儿在母亲怀里熟睡。

entries.example: Three bulbs have burned out.
entries.translation: 三个灯泡烧坏了。

entries.example: We have to show them that it's for real.
entries.translation: 我们必须让他们看到这是真的。

entries.example: I can translate from German to English pretty well, but the other way around is more difficult.
entries.translation: 我德译英相当不错，但反过来就难多了。
